Senior Backend Engineer
Bengaluru, India · Full-time

About the role
We are looking for a backend engineer to design and run the services behind our payments platform. You will own APIs end to end, from design reviews to on-call.

What you will do
- Build and scale Python and Go services on Kubernetes
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and tune slow queries
- Run Kafka pipelines that process millions of events a day
- Review code and mentor two junior engineers

What we are looking for
- 4+ years building production backend systems
- Strong Python or Go, and solid SQL
- Experience with AWS, Docker and CI/CD
- Clear written communication
